answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 5590 Country: India Title: Is the wudu gets nullified (broken) after eating the flesh of camel? Question: assalamualaikum wr wb, Is the wudu gets nullified (broken) after eating the flesh of camel? jazakallahu khairan. Answer ID: 5590 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 281/281=M/1429) Wuzu does not get nullified by eating meat of camel. It is proved by the Prophet صلي الله عليه وسلم ) ) as it is mentioned in Hdiath: كان أخر الأ مرين من رسول لله صلي ا لله عليه وسلم ترك الوضوء مما مست النار However, the traditions mentioning wuzu imply that wuzu is just mustahab i.e. it is better to make wuzu. فالأحسن ان يقال: إن الأمر بالوضو محمول علي الاستحباب و تركه بيان الجواز (اعلا ء السنن1/ ( 107 Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
